title: Rearranging formulae: isolate a variable
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what single skill is this repair problem checking?

source_reference.notes: Called by Q-015 Q015_SETUP_ADD_INSTEAD_MULTIPLY. Atomicity=alg.rearranging_formulae; Scenario=Called by Q-015 Q015_SETUP_ADD_INSTEAD_MULTIPLY; Surface variation=yes; No new vocab=yes; Steps=1-2. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: Make x the subject of x + 5 = 12.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If 5 is added again instead of subtracted, the issue is choosing the inverse operation while isolating a variable. Rearranging word-problem equations needs this control.

hint_ladder.title: Subject meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: Making x the subject means ending with x alone on one side of the equation.

hint_ladder.title: Undo plus five
hint_ladder.prompt: The x has 5 added to it, so use the inverse operation on both sides.

hint_ladder.title: Balance both sides
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is changing one side only. Whatever you subtract from the left must also be subtracted from the right.

hint_ladder.title: Subject routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Identify what is attached to x, undo it on both sides, and leave x alone. Use this equation; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on isolating x by applying the same inverse operation to both sides of the equation.
